summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: continue repairs, tests and protected merges. Finish PLF-089 / GitHub194 by retaining provider cooldown across queued completion payload edits.

delivery.outcome: Queued completion payload revisions preserve provider retry deadlines, attempts and sanitized failure history until successful retry. Protected exact-head merge and installed runtime readback.
nonGoals: No global provider backoff or incremental selection owned by PLF-091
No fleet activation or new worker
No dependencies or unrelated publication policy changes

architecture.decision: Reuse RetryQueue revision fencing. Replacing a pending/failed job with retry history carries its attempts and error, and preserves the later of now and the provider deadline. Repeated edits cannot bypass Retry-After; running/succeeded replacement semantics stay unchanged. Make the pre-existing schema discovery assertion insensitive to terminal line wrapping; verify narrow, default and wide presentation without changing schema validation behavior.
architecture.rollback: Revert protected merge; preserve queued jobs.

commands: python3 -m pytest tests/test_sync_completion.py tests/test_sync_retry.py tests/test_sync_retry_cli.py tests/test_ticket_api_events.py tests/test_ticket_update_precondition.py -q tests/test_schema_discovery.py
validation.evidence: Two genuine failed regressions on previous source, consecutive payload edits during provider cooldown, full suite, Ruff, real same-issue canary, exact head/base OneDev and independent protected merge.
